title: Fwd Cargo Door Latch Hooks and Latching Web — Installation

issue.reason: Issue D. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Installation of the latching web and the eight latch hooks on the forward cargo door, including the take-up sequence, the sensing gap setting and the three-cycle proving run with the warning system live.

sections.purpose: This task installs the right-hand latching web kit and the eight latch hooks on the forward cargo door, sets the proximity sensing gap and proves the door through three full close and open cycles.
sections.job_setup_note: Do this task with the door open and the safety struts installed. The hooks must go back in their recorded stations unless a full set is being replaced. The sensing gap is set with the feeler set, not by eye, and the setting is different for aircraft with the carriage installed. Allow time at the end for the three proving cycles; they cannot be shortened.
sections.procedure: 1. Make sure that the fastener holes are clean and that no debris is in the hook shaft bores. 2. Fit the web support frame and lift the right-hand latching web kit D5230136217763 into position. 3. Install the web fasteners in the sequence on the fastener diagram and torque them to the value in the torque table. 4. Install the inboard shear ties GRA7840-60 at each hook station and torque them. CAUTION: DO NOT TORQUE A SHEAR TIE BEFORE THE WEB IS FULLY TORQUED. THE SEAT WILL NOT SIT SQUARE. 5. Install the eight hooks in their recorded stations, working outwards from stations 4 and 5. 6. Lubricate the hook shafts with the low-temperature grease. Do not over-apply; excess grease collects dust at outstations. 7. Route the door harness on the recorded path and secure it with cable ties LN309661K1 clear of the latch travel. 8. Set the sensing gap at the upper door warning sensor 3323WT with the feeler set to the value in the setting table. WARNING: AN INCORRECT SENSING GAP CAN GIVE A LOCKED INDICATION WITH THE DOOR UNLOCKED. 9. Check the outboard skin panel HOD355133-89 fastener line for full seating. 10. Do three complete close and open cycles with the door warning system live and check that the indication follows the mechanism at every cycle. 11. Check the latch load with the spring balance at station 1 and at station 8.
sections.close_out: Remove the door safety struts and the warning notices. Do the forward cargo door operational test and the door warning system test. Record the installation, the torque values, the sensing gap and the latch loads in the aircraft technical log.

type_data.effectivity_note: All SOLANO-30 and SOLANO-34 aircraft; the sensing gap value differs pre and post MOD-133110

safety_precautions: Install the door safety struts before any person goes under the door.
Do not put a hand in the latch train during a proving cycle.
Make sure the door warning system is live for the proving cycles.
